summary: Learn to structure waste-service specifications, payment controls and monitoring scorecards. Review practical PPP tools and strengthen contract oversight.
lede: Public-private partnerships in integrated solid waste management link collection, recovery and disposal through defined service and payment terms. The five-day intermediate course is for municipal waste officers, PPP practitioners and contract managers who need to scope and oversee these services. It develops skills in drafting output specifications, allocating contract risks, and checking payments and performance with service records, baselines and KPI scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, procure, deliver or monitor public-private waste services and need to connect operational evidence with contract decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with municipal solid waste services, public procurement or public-private partnership concepts is expected. Coding is not required; spreadsheet calculations use Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet. Advanced financing and policy topics receive conceptual coverage, while contract monitoring and service-measure exercises use operational application.
